label: PDK1
collision_or_note: COLLISION: "PDK1" is also a historical alias of PDPK1 (HGNC:8816, O15530, ENSG00000140992, CHEMBL2534), the 3-phosphoinositide-dependent kinase. DGIdb returned 26 interactions for the symbol PDK1, among them BX-795, BX-912, OSU-03012 (AR-12) and celecoxib with no action type, which are PDPK1 inhibitors or PDPK1-associated agents; ChEMBL curated PDPK1 mechanism rows name AR-12 and UCN-01 under CHEMBL2534, not under the pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase target. Every PDK statement in this folder is keyed by UniProt accession.
